title: Traditional Song of the Highlands No. 49 (Rwai Lum bad Wah Vol. 7)
khasi_title: Rwai Lum bad Wah Ba-paka No. 49
cultural_context: Laments tragic legends and honors sacred rivers, peaks, and monoliths. Passed down orally through generations of Khasi and Pnar families across Meghalaya.
lyrics_khasi:
To thiah suk ko khunlung ba jem,
Ka kmie ka ieng ban synran;
Ki angel ka bneng kin da ia pha,
Haduh ban da kynjat ka sngi ba shai.
lyrics_english:
Sleep peacefully, gentle child of my heart,
Thy mother stands watchful beside thy cradle;
The celestial guardians shall watch over thee,
Until the golden rays of dawn awaken the hills.
